title: Scaffold the opum-lore plugin for federated distribution
description: Per the greenfield cutover plan (archived PLAN.md 5.1), the lore skill moves into an opum-lore plugin that lives in lore-cli and is cut by the same tag as the CLI, so a skill can never describe a CLI version that is not present. Add .claude-plugin/plugin.json plus the lore skill content to this repo. opum-agent owns opum-marketplace and will add the matching marketplace.json entry once this lands on dev and I hand it the exact repo/ref -- do not add that entry here. Any skill this plugin ships is gated by claude plugin eval per opum-agent docs/reference/plugin-eval-authoring.md.

acceptanceCriteria.text: lore-cli carries .claude-plugin/plugin.json describing the opum-lore plugin and a lore skill sourced from this repo own bridge content
claude plugin eval passes against the standards in opum-agent docs/reference/plugin-eval-authoring.md
opum-agent has been told the exact landed repo and ref so it can add the opum-marketplace entry itself
lore check exits 0 after the changes

implementationNotes: Scaffolded .claude-plugin/plugin.json (name opum-lore, version 0.4.1 matching package.json, MIT per LICENSE) and skills/lore/SKILL.md -- adapted from .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md, deliberately dropping the Commit-side-effect preflight section (that references this repo's own .codex/skills/backlog-handover/scripts/lore-authority-preflight.mjs and backlog-handover coordinator mode, which is lore-cli's internal development process, not something a downstream consumer of the shipped lore CLI has or needs) and replacing it with a generic pointer to check the consuming repository's own instructions. Authored a minimal eval suite: evals/lore-doc-request (should-fire, llm outcome grader checking the response recommends lore new/lore link over hand-editing files) and evals/lore-no-trigger (should-NOT-fire, unrelated JS question), each with a display-only tool_used:Skill grader. Piloted individually, then ran the full gate: claude plugin eval . --ablation with-without --no-publish --judge-model sonnet --threshold 1, default runs:3 -- EXIT 0. lore-doc-request: with 1.00 / without 0.00 / delta +1.00 (skill fired 1x with, 0x without, judge unanimous 3/3 both arms). lore-no-trigger: with 1.00 / without 1.00 / delta 0.00 (skill correctly did not fire in either arm). Meets the floor invariants: >=1 should-NOT-fire case, every case has an outcome grader beyond tool_used, runs:3, ablation with-without. Added **/evals/results/ to .gitignore per the opum-workflow plugin's own convention.

Reported opum-agent the exact landed repo/ref: tag v0.4.2, commit c2f3a93f51a5bf6394bdfa8d0b59b5b7a7c4ca2c, once it was on main and published (plugin.json bumped to 0.4.2 in the same release commit, matching the tag it ships on). opum-agent confirmed: 'v0.4.2 verified from here... plugin.json 0.4.2 at the tag, skill present -- and the opum-lore marketplace entry is going up now, pinned ref v0.4.2.'
finalSummary: Scaffolded the opum-lore Claude Code plugin in this repository (.claude-plugin/plugin.json + skills/lore/SKILL.md), cut by the same tag as the CLI per PLAN.md 5.1. Authored and validated a claude plugin eval suite (evals/lore-doc-request should-fire, evals/lore-no-trigger should-NOT-fire) meeting the floor invariants: full 3-run ablation gate exit 0, doc-request delta +1.00 (unanimous baseline fail), no-trigger delta 0.00 (correct shape for a guard case, skill-fired 0x). Landed as PR #567, shipped in the published 0.4.2 release (tag v0.4.2, commit c2f3a93f5). Told opum-agent the exact repo/ref; they confirmed the opum-lore marketplace entry is going up pinned to v0.4.2.
